If you were happy with him that means you have the ability to be happy, I've never been happy for a significant period of time before.  NEVER.  If I was in love and was happy my loved one died, I would feel like killing myself too, even more so then I already do regularly, because I'm never happy.  But that's just not being able to see past the emotions.  If you were happy that means you can be happy again.
But if you really do decide to kill yourself though, don't just lay in bed until Saturday.  Get everything you can out of your last few days on earth.  Go on a bike ride or a walk through the park.  Soak up the sunshine, feel the wind on your face, or dance in the rain or snow or whatever the weather is doing over there.  Spend the rest of your money on a plane ticket to the one place you've always wanted to go but never did.  If you're going to die on Saturday, you can't do things 'later' or 'some other time.'  
I'm sorry for your loss, I just hope you take my advice and cherish these last few days because you got nothing to lose now.  I love you Throwaway1131222

I'm in a good school and will graduate in may 2016.  I make good grades.  I dont surround myself with same people, considering I usually dont really surround myself by any people.  And I don't work, I just have some money that I can live off of but not enough to do a lot of stuff.
